      "name": "mining",

      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides visibility and tracking for block template memory usage to prevent memory bloat in external mining clients like Stratum v2 template providers. The PR description notes that external IPC clients can hold block templates indefinitely and keep evicted transactions pinned in memory; external client adoption is in progress in stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63."
